description: This file defines the ConfigurationException class used within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically related to client-side monitoring configuration errors. It implements an interface for monitoring events and uses a trait for monitoring functionalities.

classes.name: ConfigurationException
classes.description: An exception class representing errors related to configuration for client-side monitoring in the AWS SDK for PHP. It extends RuntimeException and implements MonitoringEventsInterface, using HasMonitoringEventsTrait.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Inherited constructor from RuntimeException; no custom constructor defined.
